mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.project_id AS projectId, m.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, m.role, m.joined_at AS joinedAt FROM project_member m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id
mapper.select: WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY m.joined_at, m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_member (project_id, user_id, role, joined_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{joinedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE project_member SET role = #{role} WHERE id = #{id}
